author: Astra
scope: Pre-meeting board election structure advice; no ballot transmission or result persistence

integration.capability_negotiation: Client checks supported task kinds and contract versions before submitting; unsupported is explicit
integration.task_granularity: One election_structure task per pinned meeting; agenda/criterion-level findings and acceptance
integration.registry_authority: Server supplies agenda/person/source IDs; model-local IDs may describe structures but cannot create voting agendas

scope_recovery.input: Cited missing/misassigned agenda or person with source window and proposed relationships
scope_recovery.server_handling: Validate allowed source and local refs; mint server IDs for source-anchored proposals as accepted_unreviewed, issue revised task packet, then reassess affected items
scope_recovery.boundary: No dependence on parser success; no invented agenda without source; citation acceptance is not proof of semantic attribution
scope_recovery.capability: Negotiated extension; old candidate adapter need not support it

binding.historical_policy_replay_requirement: Publication/availability and effective interval verified; unsupported evidence returns unsupported replay, never silently substitutes current policy
binding.date_only_rule: Only documents dated before cutoff's Korean calendar date; same-day date-only sources excluded
binding.freshness: Known-by cutoff and applicable-to target period are separate requirements
binding.prior_results: Only prior meeting results with verified earlier meeting identity; current meeting outcomes forbidden
binding.retrospective_label: A current-policy research replay is not an independent historical holdout

notation.optional_values: unknown uses null with a gap reference; absence is never zero or false
notation.record_fields: Field lists below are semantic design requirements, not JSON Schema
notation.local_references: Local IDs resolve only inside the accepted submission and its permitted agenda/person registry

condition.semantics: Conjunction; alternative branches use separate conditions; at cutoff these are scenarios, not outcomes

election_pool.count_rule: Candidate count, total board size and elected seats are different; an auditor role is not a second board seat

term_projection.semantics: Projection stays conditional; no conventional AGM date or three-year term imputation

legal_assessment.boundary: Semantic law interpretation is LLM human-unreviewed; keyword hit is only a research hint

information_gap.skip_rule: Only the first two availability kinds permit skip_criterion; other gaps must keep their true status

policy_judgment.scope: A structure concern cannot automatically mark every candidate unfit

policy_design.staggered_default: case_by_case; institution preset can prefer or oppose introduction with explicit exceptions
composition_order: Resolve scope and law applicability before invoking any legal constraint
NO_VOTE only when no ballot is required on the evaluated branch
Supported applicable prohibition constrains the affected ballot; unresolved law is not a verified violation
Material adverse effect meeting the selected rule with no supported exception => AGAINST
Material opposing findings with unresolved exception => REVIEW
At least one applicable criterion evaluated, no material adverse finding and positive or neutral basis => FOR
No evaluable criteria => REVIEW; show skipped/unassessed reasons and continue peers
policy_design.structure_candidate_join: Join by agenda and person references; retain both reasons; constrain only explicitly affected ballot
policy_design.no_weighted_cancellation: Several minor benefits cannot silently cancel one policy veto
policy_design.conservative: Tighten stated exception/materiality standards; do not invent adverse facts from missing data
policy_design.policy_changes: New policy hash; reuse source-bound fact records only after dependency validation; reassess judgments

validation_design.semantic_accuracy: Citation/hash checks do not establish correct meaning, complete evidence, or freedom from pretrained hindsight
validation_design.allocation: 1/(N+1) illustration only if simplified assumptions explicitly hold; no ballot allocation without verified eligible votes and pool constraints
validation_design.retry_limits: Reuse existing caller round/tool/research/attempt budgets; no hidden server loop. Local failures cannot consume unlimited peer budgets.

routing_design.automatic: FOR/AGAINST with accepted facts and resolved required ballot constraints can be ready_for_auto; genuine unsupported allocation remains local manual
routing_design.selective: Existing default FOR auto and AGAINST manual retained; selected agenda IDs always manual
routing_design.manual: Keep recommendations but route covered ballots to manual_review
routing_design.conditional: Advisory branch plan allowed; automatic execution readiness requires that the downstream executor can resolve the branch from authorized meeting events; current MCP submits no ballot
routing_design.missing_information: Show local exclusion; never block other agendas

lifecycle.output: cited clause changes, roster, pools and conditional projections
targeted reads or corrected items within shared budgets
JSON and Markdown with the same decisions and limitations

update_design.persistence: Request-local/server-stateless; caller may retain continuation; no user-result files or scheduled jobs
update_design.model_change: Fresh evaluator assessment identity, same packet/policy for controlled comparison; avoid prior answers in independent evaluation
update_design.source_added: Only after an allowed read; discovery titles are not evidence
update_design.source_replaced: Invalidate dependent facts and judgments, retain unrelated tasks after fingerprint checks
update_design.source_correction_after_cutoff: Exclude from same historical run; a later cutoff requires a new run
update_design.shared_dependency_changed: Invalidate every dependent task; locality does not permit reuse of stale dependencies
update_design.progress: Pending/rejected structure items do not prevent returning completed candidate/other-agenda advice

rollout.deliverable: Capability negotiation, sibling task/source registry and source adapters for official case law and company charter text
rollout.gate: Old candidate-only clients retain their contract; unsupported sources/contracts explicit; publication/version and text provenance checked before citation

rollout.deliverable: Cited structure submission and local validation
rollout.gate: Wrong company/date/hash rejected; missing criterion and malformed peer item do not halt unrelated advice

rollout.deliverable: Policy composition, branching and final rendering
rollout.gate: Same accepted facts across settings; no global keyword override; JSON/Markdown parity
Each selected annual/extraordinary meeting separate; read, submit, repair and final output exercised with caller LLM

rollout.deliverable: Independent held-out comparison and scoped release readiness
rollout.gate: Separate known research cases from unseen cases; compare model families and policy settings; deployment reported only after live checks

submission_envelope.collection_types: Each collection uses the correspondingly named records entry; every member has its local ID and dependency references
submission_envelope.evaluator_provenance: Runner records adapter name/version and prompt fingerprint; model cannot assert human review
submission_envelope.empty_collections: Allowed with explicit scope finding and source coverage; empty is never proof of no adverse facts
submission_envelope.dependency_validation: Every finding/judgment references accepted facts or identified unresolved gaps; rejected facts invalidate dependent judgments

value_types.identifiers: Nonempty strings, server scope for agenda/person/source and submission scope for local records
value_types.counts: Nonnegative integers or null with a gap; charter bounds and occupied/elected seats are different units
value_types.terms: Explicit numeric quantity plus unit (years/months/days) or source-defined end event; no numeric coercion from unknown
value_types.dates: ISO 8601 calendar dates; exact instants require timezone and availability evidence
value_types.completeness: Explicit boolean or unknown with a gap; row count does not prove complete roster
value_types.conditions: condition_ref=null means unconditional within pinned scope; other refs resolve to all_of predicates; alternative branches remain separate
value_types.citations: Quote must occur in the allowed immutable source window under documented normalization; document hash alone does not authorize unseen text

source_readiness.audit_basis: Read-only repository paths, not a new live end-to-end run
missing_integrated_paths: DART charter attachment body selection and company charter historical version resolution
official case-law search/read and temporal evidence binding
source_readiness.gate: Server verifies allowed source, immutable text hash, availability/version evidence and read window before source manifest inclusion
source_readiness.pdf_boundary: No PDF/OCR ingestion in this repository; unsupported format or independently supplied source-traceable text through a separate documented adapter
source_readiness.no_peeking: Decision/date metadata alone does not prove public text availability; future AGM results cannot establish pre-meeting charter state
source_readiness.acquisition_strategy: On-demand relevant clauses/cases; no full corpus completion prerequisite

dart_attachment_contract.discovery: Compare document.xml member inventory and DART attachment index; missing XML member is not proof of absent attachment
dart_attachment_contract.reading: Dedicated supported-format service; retain existing main-document reader behavior
dart_attachment_contract.formats: XML/HTML/text allowed; PDF-only explicitly unsupported in this repository
dart_attachment_contract.readiness: Discovery metadata is not readable evidence until body obtained and verified

source_readiness.report_attachment_rule: Do not assume all annual/half-yearly/quarterly reports have identical charter attachment requirements; annual-report charter attachments are the first lookup path.
